design_condition: The building is positioned along the street, preserving generous landscape space toward the listed buildings while adapting its staggered geometry to the sloping road.

positive.statement: The positioning in relation to the existing facility, street space, and landscape is beautiful.
The facade appears calm, inviting, and exciting at the same time.
The entrance zone and movement zones are spacious and well proportioned.
The day school is well structured and offers varied opportunities for different activities and age groups.
The building technology and installation concept are clearly structured and well documented.

negative.statement: The main uses along the busy street will hardly allow windows to be opened during lessons.
The corridors cannot be furnished for fire safety reasons.
Orientation within the rooms seems difficult.
The corridors largely lack natural light, and the basement design rooms have limited lighting.
The entrance area is rather small considering the number of children.
The arrangement of parking spaces between the two playgrounds is incomprehensible and difficult to correct.
The organization is not convincing, and reservations remain regarding internal functional connections.
The insulation thicknesses still need optimization to achieve the required energy standard.
The relatively large floor area results in comparatively high construction costs.
